1.title: Video Shows Deck Collapsing as Officers Serve Warrant in Missouri
1.summary: Footage from a body-worn camera showed the officers and U.S. marshals at the door of a residence in Huntsville, Mo., as a deck gave way beneath them last month.

2.title: California Arson Suspect Pleads Not Guilty Again After Stunning Mistrial
2.summary: The man accused of setting the blaze that later turned deadly in the Pacific Palisades is now readying for a new prosecution after a previous effort in June failed.

3.title: In Wyoming’s G.O.P. Primaries, an Emphatic Rebuke of the Hard Right
3.summary: The Wyoming Freedom Caucus had ambitions for a total takeover of elected state government. But its candidates were rejected from the governor’s mansion to the Legislature.

4.title: Israel Opens Criminal Investigation Into Killings of Hind Rajab and Gaza Medical Workers
4.summary: Two high-profile cases that had spurred international condemnation of the country’s conduct in Gaza were transferred to the military police. Such investigations have rarely led to convictions.

5.title: Ecuador intelligence chief and five Americans killed in Kenya helicopter crash
5.summary: Michele Sensi-Contugi, and his wife Stephany Hollihan among the seven people killed in the crash.

6.title: 81-year-old confesses to German cold case murder of US tourist in 1994
6.summary: Amy Lopez from Texas was last seen alive in September 1994 while on a visit to a fortress in Koblenz.
